title: Great day at the beach
text: Beautiful day at the beach, I recommend to rent a lounge chair and umbrella the sun was hot 🥵. Also swim shoes, the beach is not sandy it’s small rocks that are not easy to walk on.
author: Teresa_B

title: Nice day at the beach
text: We had a nice time on the state trip. We really just wanted to go to the beach for a day and have it be easy to get there and back. The optional little walking tour is nice if you’re interested in learning about the medieval castle. But overall, it’s a great experience if you wanna have several hours at the beach and not worry about how to get there and just enjoy your day in the sun.
author: Jane_N

title: A Beautiful Day In Costa Brava
text:
We had such a wonderful time visiting Costa Brava from Barcelona! The whole beach town was absolutely beautiful, and the views from the castle were breathtaking. It was even more beautiful in person than I expected.

I really enjoyed having some free time to explore at our own pace, enjoy a nice lunch, and visit the three beautiful beaches. There was a perfect mix of sightseeing and relaxing, and the scenery was incredible throughout the day.

It was definitely one of the highlights of our trip to Spain, and I would happily recommend this day trip to anyone visiting Barcelona. A beautiful and

title: A trip not to miss! Tossa de Mar
text:

We had a wonderful day in Tossa de Mar! From start to finish, the tour was extremely well organized. Check-in, boarding the bus, and arriving at our destination were all easy, smooth, and efficient.
